title.narrative: Second Rural Water Supply and Sanitation Sector Project

description.narrative: The Project is designed to expand access to improved rural water supply and sanitation (RWSS), and improve health of rural residents in 6 project provinces around the Tonle Sap basin in Cambodia.

contact-info.website: https://www.adb.org/forms/request-information-form?topic=projects&source=PDS&subject=38560-022 (Closed)&officer= shasanah@adb.org&division= Urban Development and Water Division, SERD&projectcountry= Cambodia

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President

description.narrative: Access to improved RWSS in selected communes of six provinces in the Tonle Sap Basin increased.

100% of households in 59 communes (639 rural villages) especially women, have access to improved water sources. Progress/Status: Achieved. 100% of households in 53 communes (594 rural villages) have access to improved water sources. Data Source: Baseline and follow-up surveys in the target project communes and villages
